source.title: Formal Theory of Creativity, Fun, and Intrinsic Motivation (1990-2010)
source.venue: IEEE Transactions on Autonomous Mental Development 2(3):230-247

confidence_rationale: Foundational formalisation of learning-progress-as-compression-progress that MECH-314c already cites (Schmidhuber 1991). Very high source quality. Direction is MIXED, not pure support: it corroborates the derivative-of-model-quality signal REE registered, but Schmidhuber's own framing folds curiosity, creativity, and skill acquisition into a SINGLE scalar intrinsic reward on ONE world-model+controller, which is exactly the single-functional framing REE's three-incommensurable-channels design (ARC-021/MECH-069) deliberately rejects. It is therefore simultaneously supporting evidence for MECH-314c and a documented instance of the design REE argues against.
failure_signatures: The intrinsic reward is a single scalar (compression progress) maximised by one RL controller -- a wireheading/self-delusion surface: the agent can be drawn to data it can trivially make more compressible, and the theory needs the environment to supply genuinely novel learnable regularity to avoid degenerate loops.

Compression progress rewards improving the WORLD MODEL (knowledge), not achieving GOALS (competence); Schmidhuber acknowledges skills are acquired only as a side effect of seeking compressible data, so it does not by itself guarantee the agent crosses a behavioural competence floor.

Requires a compressor whose improvement is measurable and attributable to the agent's actions; in high-dimensional stochastic input the compression-progress estimate is noisy and can misattribute environmental change to agent learning.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Intrinsic reward should equal the agent's COMPRESSION PROGRESS: the number of bits saved in encoding the observed history before vs after a learning step. A separate RL controller maximizes expected future compression progress, driving the agent to create or discover novel patterns that are 'interesting' -- neither fully random (incompressible) nor already known (already compressed). Curiosity, creativity, art, science, and humour are all cast as this one drive; skills are acquired as a by-product of seeking better-compressible data.
mapping.ree_translation: Schmidhuber's compression progress is the information-theoretic form of MECH-314c's learning-progress bonus (|PE_t - PE_{t-K}|): both reward the DERIVATIVE of model quality rather than its level. The 1991 'curious model-building controller' Schmidhuber cites is one of the two references already embedded in the MECH-314c claim title. It grounds MECH-314c's information-theoretic legitimacy and supplies the 'interestingness = intermediate compressibility' intuition for tuning the bonus.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Two departures REE must own. (1) Schmidhuber's is a SINGLE-SCALAR objective on a unified model+controller; REE's ARC-021/MECH-069 commit to three incommensurable channels (viability / social / epistemic) that must NOT be collapsed to one number, so REE can adopt the compression-progress SIGNAL for the epistemic channel only, not the whole objective. (2) Compression progress rewards world-model improvement (knowledge-based IM), whereas WS-1's competence floor is a behavioural-GOAL-achievement problem (competence-based IM, cf. Baldassarre & Mirolli) -- Schmidhuber gets skills only as a by-product, which is exactly the failure REE is seeing (curiosity substrate wired, foraging competence still zero).
mapping.source_context: Theoretical/formal review spanning 1990-2010 across simulated artificial-scientist agents; no biological substrate (MECH-314c is flagged as the least biologically-anchored of the three MECH-314 sub-flavours). Pure computational-theory transfer into the REE RL frame.

confidence_components.notes: Source quality very high (canonical, ~900 citations, already cited by the claim). Mapping fidelity held to 0.60 by the single-scalar-objective mismatch with REE's three-channel design and the knowledge-vs-competence gap. Transfer risk 0.40: the compression-progress estimator's noise properties in stochastic high-dim input are a real obstacle REE's broadcast-scalar proxy would inherit.
